content: - Before releasing or forward-testing `OpenStrategyHash`-bound exits, trace the receiver in live `TradeLineCustom.CanOrderComplete`, historical `BuildMinuteClose`/environment construction, and forward `CheckTestResults` separately. On 2026-10-03 the first two populated the opening hash, but `CheckTestResults` saved it in the row without assigning it to the expression environment, leaving the `InitParseEnv` default empty. Therefore historical success did not prove forward routing: compare confirmed-family decisions with the recorded hash and with an empty hash, including the emergency branch. Recheck current code; keep affected candidates research-only until every intended receiver propagates the hash. Do not fix production code, switch strategy risk, or insert templates without the appropriate task authorization.
